scope: Headless local Showdown; opening states plus a deterministic forced-switch request after one turn

forced_switch_fixture.setup: Replay the same Public Counterplay choices in equivalent worlds after team preview; assert that at least one side has forceSwitch in the resulting request
forced_switch_fixture.selection: Unselected by team 1234, so its set remains unrevealed and cannot affect the battle transition

compared: Round430 policy action, log probability, and value
result: All 12 cases passed. The forced-switch side's decisions were invariant; the side marked waiting was checked using the no-choice sentinel.
reproduction: PYTHONPATH=. POKEMON_SHOWDOWN_PATH=/path/to/local/pokemon-showdown OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/env/test_headless_hidden_invariance.py -q
limitations: This covers one forced-switch fixture and controlled hidden-set perturbations. It does not certify live-server state parity, multi-turn reveal histories, every forced replacement type, or complete training-data provenance.
